sections.title: Command Registry
sections.content: Defines red/green validation commands for canonical evidence, migration, runtime policy, acceptance pipeline, projection/segmentation, semantic import, rollout regression, and terminal validation. Commands are non-shell Python test invocations with bounded timeouts and mapped ARBE acceptance IDs. Terminal coverage requires all owner-owned green programs; authorizes is empty.

sections.title: Requirements And Acceptance
sections.content: Defines ARBE-001 through ARBE-022 across canonical evidence, migration, admission and closure, route and review policy, segmentation, runtime retry controls, Bootstrap import, historical evidence, telemetry, and acceptance modes. Observable criteria require identity-bound evidence, fail-closed validation, no authority from advisory content, preserved historical failures, mandatory-route protections, and Acceptance-only lifecycle publication.
